# Gaurav Consulting

> > Gaurav Consulting is a premier SAP S/4HANA training institute offering comprehensive certification courses in finance, supply chain, and development modules through live, online, and self-paced formats.

Based in Pune, Gaurav Consulting specializes in SAP S/4HANA training and certification with expertise across finance modules (FICO, FM, CO), supply chain management (FSCM, EWM), and development technologies (ABAP RAP, Fiori). The institute provides multiple learning formats including live instructor-led training, on-demand video courses, and corporate training solutions with job assistance and community support.

## Key Topics

- SAP S/4HANA
- SAP FICO Finance
- Financial Supply Chain Management (FSCM)
- SAP Controlling (CO)
- SAP Funds Management (FM)
- SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)
- SAP ABAP RAP
- SAP Fiori
- Online Training
- Certification Courses
- Live Training
- Self-Paced Learning
- Corporate Training
- Job Assistance
- Community Forum
